Class ShopInventoryGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.shop.ShopInventoryGenerator

Builds a varied shop inventory from Team 6's current card library.

    • createShop

      public ShopService createShop(int offerCount, int minStock, int maxStock)
      Generates a shop from a random subset of currently registered cards.

      If fewer valid cards are available than requested, every valid card is offered once.

      Parameters:
      offerCount - maximum number of distinct cards to offer
      minStock - minimum stock for each offer, inclusive
      maxStock - maximum stock for each offer, inclusive
      Returns:
      independent shop service for one encounter
